conclusion: One demonstrated pure transform/check input-fidelity issue should be refused or corrected before integration: non-routing image pins may reference the old Default via padstack, while the rename decision considers only fixed wiring. No demonstrated final Native false-admission defect; actual exporter reachability remains unproved. issues.title: Preserve or refuse every reference before renaming the old via padstack
issues.mechanism: The copy-versus-rename condition uses only fixed_via from wiring. audit_mapping verifies the declared routing via stack but does not forbid library/image/pin from referencing that same valid stack. With no fixed via, a changed target renames the only old stack; image pin atoms remain unchanged and become dangling. check recomputes this same transformation and accepts it.
issues.counterexample: Existing owned fixture with fixed=False; change library/image/pin padstack atom from Pad to existing Via[0-1]_600:300_um. Both transform and check pass. Raw pin resolves to a raw stack; guided pin retains old ID while library has only Pad and Via[0-1]_1500:300_um.
issues.fixed_via_control: Same fixture with fixed=True keeps the old stack plus derived stack, so the pin reference resolves.
issues.impact: The pure receipt can certify an edit that breaks non-routing pin/padstack semantics. Engine failure or downstream Native refusal remains possible and no acceptance was demonstrated.
issues.reachability_limit: A constructed valid-grammar API counterexample, not evidence that pinned KiCad10.0.7 currently exports this padstack reuse. No Native/exporter/source dataset was executed or newly inspected for reachability.
issues.recommended_small_fix: Fail closed if the routing-via padstack is referenced by any image pin when its ID/dimensions would change, or preserve that original stack for all such references and add a separate derived routing stack. Keep pin nodes/old shape unchanged. Add a narrow regression asserting refusal or reference resolution for both transform and check.
issues.integration_disposition: Resolve this reference-preservation hole before treating the helper as an exact permitted-edit contract.

pure_reproduction.python:
from test_default_targets import fixtures, inputs, SOURCE
from autorouter import default_targets as m, sexpr as sx
from autorouter.adapter import _parse_dsn, _dump_dsn
for fixed in (False, True):
    raw, native, project, task = fixtures(fixed=fixed)
    tree = _parse_dsn(raw.decode()); library = sx.one(tree, 'library')
    old = 'Via[0-1]_600:300_um'
    sx.children(sx.children(library, 'image')[0], 'pin')[0][1] = '"' + old + '"'
    raw = _dump_dsn(tree).encode(); args = inputs(raw, native, project, task)
    guided, receipt = m.transform(*args, source=SOURCE)
    m.check(raw, guided, receipt, *args[1:], source=SOURCE)
    library = sx.one(_parse_dsn(guided.decode()), 'library')
    pin = sx.unquote(sx.children(sx.children(library, 'image')[0], 'pin')[0][1])
    stacks = {sx.unquote(row[1]) for row in sx.children(library, 'padstack')}
    print(fixed, pin, sorted(stacks), pin in stacks)

assessed_contracts.assessment: Inputs are bytes and immutable; project JSON duplicate keys refuse; Native map is JSON-copied before checking. Native source/project/task hashes and board_savedFalse are required. Original Default scalar values must equal Native rows and raw DSN class/via dimensions. Parent values/specified flags/names/priorities are explicit and consistent across every net. No source class is rewritten.

Reused derive computes max(raw,width/clearance floor), max(raw drill,hole floor), and max(raw diameter,via floor,derived drill+2annulus). It refuses off-grid values rather than rounding; typed smd_smd/global/class clearance are strengthened explicitly. No new algorithmic completion implication follows.

Fixed wires/vias are kept as exact DSN nodes. One rawDefault fullthrough-via is allowed; if fixed wiring references it and target changes, old stack remains and a new stack is added. Collision refuses. DT-001 is the missing non-routing-reference case.

Native schema requires actual int1, integer-nm units and literal10.0.7 through opt-in raw audit; DSN host10.0.7/um/resolution10 and exact2Cu known versions or strict modern4Cu source/Native layer tables are required. Unknown/mismatched inputs refuse. The literal map version does not prove actual selected/executed tools.

derive_default_targets requires exact bool; true refuses parent_policy, experimental toolchain objects and non-singleDefault project modes. Existing calls defaultFalse and retain prior below-floor refusal. The derived raw audit is explicitly marked raw_default_for_target_derivation_only and never routing acceptance.

check reconstructs full expected guided bytes and canonical receipt, rejecting rehashed arbitrary output/metadata changes. It cannot independently discover a transform algorithm error such as DT-001; Native execution/production support remainFalse.

integration_conditions.condition: Guard actual normal selected10.0.7, exact raw DSN/map process+source snapshots and shared source/task/final SCH/class/PRL/cleanup/original/protected proof. Pure literal version/source hashes do not replace actual Native execution.

Retain raw NativeDSN/map plus guided stage/receipt, replay source-derived mandatory policy and exact subsequent adapter/edge composition. Missing or edited policy cannot fall back to historical rawDefault behavior. Never pass derive_default_targets=True to unrelated final acceptance audits.
